globalNotes: Dark theme throughout. Top section background is a dark blue-grey gradient (~#2A323B at top fading to near-black #0E1114 in the middle). The lower "Time in Bed" area is near-black (#0A0C0E). The bottom ALARM panel sits on a slightly lighter slate card (~#39434D) with rounded top corners, anchored to the bottom of the screen. Status bar at very top: time "09:36" left with a muted/silent bell icon (notifications-off) beside it; right side shows cellular signal bars, wifi icon, and battery glyph reading "39". This is a modal/full-screen sheet (has an X close button top-left). Screen is a single non-scrolling layout (one screenshot covers the whole view).

layout.name: Status bar
layout.description: iOS status bar. Left: '09:36' in white bold, with a small muted bell (notifications-silenced) icon immediately to its right. Right: cellular signal bars, wifi glyph, battery outline with '39' inside it. White/light-grey icons on dark background.

layout.name: Header bar
layout.description: Top navigation row. Left: white 'X' close icon (thin stroke). Center: title 'SLEEP PLANNER' in white, uppercase, letter-spaced, semibold ~17px; immediately right of the title a small circular '?' help icon (grey outline circle with grey question mark). Right: a circular outlined button containing a calendar-with-clock (sleep schedule) icon, white thin stroke.
layout.interaction: X closes the modal/sheet; '?' opens help/info about Sleep Planner; calendar icon opens the sleep schedule view.

layout.name: SCHEDULE badge
layout.description: Small pill/badge below the right calendar icon, right-aligned. Text 'SCHEDULE' in white uppercase bold ~11px on a gradient background running orange -> pink -> magenta -> purple (left to right). Rounded corners.
layout.interaction: Tapping likely opens the schedule/auto-schedule feature.

layout.name: WHOOP logo mark
layout.description: Centered circular outline icon containing the WHOOP 'W' wordmark logomark (stylized w/peaks). Thin white circle outline, white logo. Decorative branding element.

layout.name: Recommendation headline
layout.description: Centered two-line headline in white, regular/medium weight ~26px, with the numbers in the same weight. Reads: 'Go to bed at 23:30 today to achieve a 76% Sleep Consistency tomorrow.' Center-aligned, spanning nearly full width.
literals: Go to bed at 23:30 today to achieve a 76% Sleep Consistency tomorrow.

layout.name: Goal selector label
layout.description: Centered small uppercase grey label 'TOMORROW I WANT TO', letter-spaced ~13px, sits above the goal pill button.

layout.name: Goal pill button
layout.description: Centered rounded-rectangle (fully pill) outlined button with thin white border, transparent fill. Text 'IMPROVE MY SLEEP' centered in white uppercase semibold ~15px.
layout.interaction: Tapping opens a selector to change the sleep goal (e.g. Peak / Perform / Get By / Improve My Sleep), which changes the suggested bedtime and optimal window.

layout.name: Divider line
layout.description: Thin faint horizontal rule spanning full width, separating the upper recommendation section from the lower Time-in-Bed visualization. Color ~#2A2F35.

layout.name: Suggested time to bed (left endpoint)
layout.description: Left-aligned column near left third. Large white time '23:30' bold ~44px. Below it grey uppercase label on two lines 'SUGGESTED TIME TO BED', letter-spaced ~13px, center-aligned under the time.
layout.interaction: none (display); represents the left edge of the time-in-bed bar

layout.name: Your wake time (right endpoint)
layout.description: Right-aligned column near right third. Large white time '07:30' bold ~44px. Below it grey uppercase label 'YOUR WAKE TIME', letter-spaced ~13px, center-aligned under the time.
layout.interaction: none (display); represents the right edge of the time-in-bed bar

layout.name: Time in Bed bar (hatched range bar with dropdown stems)
layout.description: Horizontal range visualization. Two thin vertical dotted/dashed white stems drop down from the 23:30 (left) and 07:30 (right) values to the bar, marking the bedtime and wake endpoints. The bar itself is a horizontal grey diagonally-hatched/striped band (dark grey #2E343A with lighter diagonal stripes) running between the two endpoints. Centered on the bar is a white-outlined pill containing '8:00' (the time-in-bed duration) in white bold. Above the pill, centered, a small white uppercase label 'TIME IN BED' (~13px, letter-spaced). The hatched band has solid white vertical end-caps at both the left and right ends.
layout.interaction: The endpoints/bar are draggable to adjust bedtime and wake time, updating the duration and the 23:30/07:30 values.

layout.name: Optimal window bracket
layout.description: Below the Time-in-Bed bar: a wide blue dashed bracket (downward U / brace shape) spanning wider than the hatched bar, drawn in a light blue (~#5B7FA6 / steel blue) dashed line. Centered on the bracket the label 'OPTIMAL' in the same blue, uppercase letter-spaced ~13px. Below the bracket, centered, the range '00:00 - 08:25' in the same muted blue ~15px. This shows the optimal sleep window which is wider than the suggested 8h window.

layout.name: ALARM panel header row
layout.description: Bottom anchored slate card (lighter than background, ~#39434D, rounded top corners). Header row: left a small white wrist-band/strap icon (watch on wrist outline). Center: 'ALARM' in white uppercase bold ~17px, letter-spaced, centered. Right: an iOS-style toggle switch in the OFF state (knob to the left, track grey ~#6B7178, no green fill).
layout.interaction: Toggle enables/disables the haptic alarm on the band. Currently OFF.

layout.name: ALARM SET TO card (left)
layout.description: Bottom-left rounded rectangle card on a slightly darker slate fill (~#2C343C) with subtle border. Top line grey uppercase label 'ALARM SET TO' (~13px, letter-spaced, centered). Below it white bold value 'OFF' (~20px, centered).
layout.interaction: Tapping opens the alarm time picker / setting (currently OFF).

layout.name: WAKE TIME SET TO card (right)
layout.description: Bottom-right rounded rectangle card on a slightly darker slate fill (~#2C343C). Top line grey uppercase label 'WAKE TIME SET TO' (~13px, letter-spaced, centered). Below it white bold value '07:30' (~20px, centered).
layout.interaction: Tapping opens the wake-time picker to change the target wake time (currently 07:30).

charts.name: Time in Bed range bar
charts.series: Single horizontal hatched/striped band (dark grey #2E343A with lighter diagonal stripes) representing the planned time-in-bed window between bedtime (left) and wake (right). White solid vertical end-caps at both ends; thin white dashed vertical stems connect the band ends up to the 23:30 and 07:30 time labels.
charts.xAxis: Time of day; left endpoint anchored at 23:30 (suggested bedtime), right endpoint at 07:30 (wake time). No tick labels along the axis itself.
charts.notes: Centered white-outlined pill annotation '8:00' = duration in bed, with 'TIME IN BED' label above. Below sits a separate blue dashed OPTIMAL bracket spanning a wider range labeled 'OPTIMAL' with sub-range '00:00 - 08:25'. Colors: band grey #2E343A; endcaps/stems white; OPTIMAL bracket+text steel blue ~#5B7FA6.

excluded: SCHEDULE gradient badge is a WHOOP auto-scheduling/coaching feature surfaced visually but it is a core sleep-planner control, not a community/AI element, so it is kept in layout — no community, social feed, or 'Ask WHOOP Coach' AI elements are present on this screen to exclude.
